title: Hecke Transport of Conifold Mixed-Hodge Extensions: Localized Survival and Higher Derived Attachments
content: We study extension-sensitive Hecke transport of conifold mixed-Hodge modules through elementary $GL_2$ modifications of Higgs bundles. For the determinantal threefold node, an invariant-line incidence family realizes two small resolutions and their $A_1$ Springer intersection. Smooth Higgs evaluation and a codimension-two Gysin calculation preserve the source Yoneda class, while first-jet vanishing theorems establish nonempty admissible loci in explicit genus and determinant ranges. On a rank-one modified-Higgs target open $U$, a canonical kernel-branch inverse proves nonvanishing of both ordinary and exceptional unit-kernel pushforwards. On a smaller saturated open $U'$, the unframed inverse correspondence is finite flat of degree two. Under specified equivariant mixed-Hodge and descent hypotheses, the surviving morphism defines a nonzero degree-two derived class, giving a nontrivial Postnikov attachment between adjacent perverse cohomology objects. We further identify the Springer intersection with a bounded affine-Grassmannian convolution slice and establish morphism-level compatibility under explicit specialization hypotheses.
